note: Risk Agent thresholds (owner-approved 2026-11-25). Override the whole file with env RISK_AGENT_CONFIG=/path/to/file.json; unknown or invalid values fail loudly instead of falling back silently.

ohlson.note: Total assets are divided by this many USD before the deflator (1000 = USD thousands). Set provisional=false only after the unit is confirmed from Ohlson (1980).

leases.note: Non-US filers: lease liabilities are added to total debt (leverage) and lease interest to interest expense when interest was taken from the InterestExpense tag (FinanceCosts already contains it).
